original_test_intent: Inspect and, when explicitly approved, change one precisely scoped BMC firmware-firewall rule, verify its allow/deny enforcement and restore the exact original policy without losing management access.
original_method: Master remains TBD. Review requires a versioned supported firewall package with distinct read/list, scoped set and restore operations; no raw command is guessed.
manual_activity: Security/FAE owner selects the supported package, exact narrow rule, allow/deny matrix, independent recovery route, maintenance window and rollback criteria.
safety_requirements: Never filter the only recovery path
agent_execution_scope: Read and decode complete scoped baseline
Re-read every field and verify recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek correctly refuses an undefined high-risk operation but omits safe discovery and the package/recovery contract.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the engineer-approved versioned firewall tool to read first; only after approval apply one smallest-scope rule, verify harmless enforcement and restore the captured baseline. Never invent a raw setter or reset.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master TBD and 10/5 timing remain preserved; tool, rule and expected result are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Separate immutable discovery from an approved narrow write-enforce-restore transaction with independent access and exact field-level audit.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds package contract, scope, meaningful criteria and recovery to an undefined source.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read/list evidence alone is partial and cannot prove configuration enforcement; conversely a blocked probe without exact baseline/readback cannot prove the intended rule changed safely.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A broad or misencoded rule can lock out all management or expose prohibited commands, and a blind reset may destroy unrelated policy.

project_override_considerations: Any vendor firewall API is acceptable only with engineer approval and equivalent rule scope, complete baseline/readback, harmless enforcement and exact restore; it must record uncovered original-tool behavior.
expected_evidence: Immutable complete pre-rule baseline and parser version
Redacted narrow set response and field-level readback
Independent recovery validation and non-target command audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master method and criteria are absent/TBD rather than contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The firewall-configuration purpose is identifiable. Package semantics, narrow rule, baseline, probes, recovery and approval are execution-readiness inputs; execution remains gated.

review_improvement: Defines the missing read/change/enforce/restore lifecycle and prevents wildcard changes, blind resets, read-only coverage substitution and silent management lockout.
independent_technical_reasoning: Firmware firewall rules may be hierarchical across channel, LUN, NetFn, command and sub-function, so an apparently narrow mask can affect far more traffic than intended. Safety requires decoding the complete baseline, applying one explicit delta from an independent path, testing both a permitted and denied harmless command, and proving exact restoration rather than relying on regained connectivity alone.
